gold_note: Eusauropod strict consensus, read by eye with the dense parts at 1.6-2x. Seven clade names, each beside a node dot or joined to it by a curve, are kept as internal labels (Eusauropoda, Mamenchisauridae, Neosauropoda, Diplodocoidea, Flagellicaudata, Rebbachisauridae, Macronaria). Polytomies: Neosauropoda (Haplocanthosaurus, Diplodocoidea, Macronaria; stem entering between them), the four diplodocids, Histriasaurus-Zapalasaurus-the rest, and Rebbachisaurus-Rayososaurus-limaysaurines (Rayososaurus' line crosses the node's vertical and is read as its stem, as in earlier batches). Replacement for morrison2026a_fig6 (seed 20261217). 41 tips, 4 polytomies (3, 4, 3, 3 children); 7 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 5 case (census 2, seed 20261215). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
